label: My Invoices & Receipts
help_text: React island: Member portal My Invoices page. Displays a filterable list of the member's invoices from associated Deals that have a xero_invoice_pdf_url. Missing PDF URLs gracefully show 'Receipt processing - check back shortly' per CLAUDE.md §10.1. Data populated via workflow-synced contact properties. Place on my-invoices.html (portal layout).
